title: Chemiosmotic Hypothesis
goal: Dono raaston mein kisi bhi electron ne ADP ko chhua tak nahi; toh ATP bana kaise?
misaal: baandh: lumen ke H⁺ ruka paani, ATP synthase turbine

facts.fact: Chloroplast mein ATP banne ka tarika chemiosmotic hypothesis samjhati hai.
Hypothesis: kisi baat ko samjhane ke liye diya gaya vichaar, jise prayogon se parkha jaata hai.
Naam ke hisse: chemi = rasayanik kaam (ATP banana), osmotic = membrane ke aar-paar kisi cheez ka bahna (yahan H⁺ ka).
1961 mein Peter Mitchell ne yeh vichaar diya; pehle vaigyanik electron aur ATP ke beech seedha rasayanik jod maante the; prayogon ne Mitchell ko sahi saabit kiya, 1978 mein Nobel puraskaar.

Thylakoid ka naksha: chloroplast mein chapti thailiyan (thylakoid), unke dher grana; thaili ki deewar thylakoid membrane, andar ki band jagah lumen, bahar ka gaadha dravya stroma; photosystems aur carriers isi membrane mein.
H⁺ kya hai: hydrogen atom = ek proton + ek electron; electron nikal jaaye toh bacha positive proton, isliye H⁺ = hydrogen ion = proton.
Diffusion (class 9): koi cheez zyada wali jagah se apne-aap kam wali jagah ki taraf failti hai.
Proton gradient: membrane ke ek taraf H⁺ zyada, doosri taraf kam, yaani H⁺ ki dhalaan; gradient = dhalaan.
Respiration ki tarah photosynthesis mein bhi ATP banna membrane ke aar-paar proton gradient banne se juda hai.
Photosynthesis mein yeh membrane thylakoid ki hai.
Farq: yahan H⁺ membrane ke andar ki taraf, yaani lumen mein, jama hote hain.
Lumen: thylakoid ki thaili ke andar ki band jagah.
Mitochondria ki do membranes (bahar wali, andar wali); andar wali membrane mein electron carriers ki kadi hoti hai.
ETS = electron transport system, electron carriers ki kadi.
Respiration mein electron ETS se guzarte hain toh H⁺ mitochondria ke intermembrane space mein jama hote hain.
Intermembrane space: mitochondria ki dono membranes ke beech ki patli jagah.
Proton gradient kya banata hai, yeh samajhne ke liye electron ke activation aur transport ke kadam dobara dekhne hain (Figure 11.7).
Activation of electrons: roshni P680 (PS II) aur P700 (PS I) par padti hai aur electron energy lekar uchhalta hai.
Uchhle electron ko primary acceptor pakadta hai, phir woh electron carriers ki kadi mein aage badhta hai: yahi transport.
Figure 11.7 dikhati hai ki electron ka raasta aur H⁺ ka jamaav kaise jude hain, aur teen jagah H⁺ ka hisaab badalta hai.
Andar likha lumen, high H⁺; bahar stroma, low H⁺.
Roshni ke teer P680 (PS II) aur P700 (PS I) par.
PS II ke paas andar paani toot-ta hai; ½O₂ kyunki paani ke ek molecule se aadha O₂ molecule milta hai.
Electron ka raasta: PS II → PQ (plastoquinone) → cytochrome b6f → PC (plastocyanin) → PS I.
PS I → Fd (ferredoxin) → NADP reductase, jo NADP⁺ se NADPH banata hai (Z scheme ka raasta).
H⁺ ke teer stroma se lumen ki taraf; sab lumen mein jama.
Ek machine (membrane mein dhansa hissa, bahar nikla hissa) se H⁺ lumen se stroma lautte hain, aur ADP + Pᵢ se ATP banta hai.
Tikona nishaan andar high se bahar low: electro = charge (H⁺ positive), chemical = ginti (andar H⁺ zyada).

lines.says: Ab ek baat par gaur karo: dono raaston mein kisi bhi electron ne ADP ko chhua tak nahi. Toh ATP bana kaise?
ATP bana kaise, yahi aaj ka sawaal hai: chloroplast mein ATP asal mein banta kaise hai.
Aksar hum sochte hain ki electron daudte-daudte khud ATP bana deta hai. Bahut saalon tak vaigyanik bhi kuch aisa hi maante the: ki electron ki daud aur ATP ke beech koi seedha rasayanik jod hai.
1961 mein Peter Mitchell naam ke vaigyanik ne ek naya vichaar diya. Baad mein prayogon ne use sahi saabit kiya, aur iske liye unhe 1978 mein Nobel puraskaar mila.
Kisi baat ko samjhane ke liye diya gaya aisa vichaar, jise prayogon se parkha jaata hai, hypothesis kehlata hai. Mitchell ke vichaar ka naam hai chemiosmotic hypothesis.

Naam ko todo toh poora vichaar samajh aa jaata hai. Chemi yaani rasayanik kaam, yahan ATP banana. Osmotic, jaise class 9 ka osmosis, yaani membrane ke aar-paar kisi cheez ka bahna; yahan H⁺ ka. Toh naam hi keh raha hai: membrane ke aar-paar H⁺ bahenge, aur us bahav se ATP banega.
Pehle jagah pakki kar lo. Chloroplast ke andar chapti-chapti thailiyan hoti hain, jinhe thylakoid kehte hain; inke dher ko grana kehte hain.
Har thaili ki deewar thylakoid membrane hai. Thaili ke andar ki band jagah lumen hai, aur thaili ke bahar, chloroplast ka gaadha dravya, stroma hai.
Socho paani se bhara ek balloon, jo paani ki baalti mein tair raha hai: balloon ki rubber membrane hai, balloon ke andar ka paani lumen hai, aur baalti ka paani stroma.
Is poori film mein andar ka matlab lumen, aur bahar ka matlab stroma. PS II, PS I aur electron carriers isi membrane mein, ya uske theek paas, baithe hain.
Ab H⁺ ko pehchano. Hydrogen ke atom mein ek proton aur ek electron hota hai. Electron nikal jaaye, toh bachta hai sirf ek proton, jis par positive charge hai.
Isliye H⁺ ko hydrogen ion bhi kehte hain aur proton bhi; teeno naam ek hi cheez ke hain.
Class 9 mein aapne padha tha: koi cheez jahan zyada hoti hai, wahan se apne-aap kam wali jagah ki taraf failti hai, jaise kamre mein agarbatti ki khushboo.
Yeh dhalaan jaisa hai: gend dhalaan par apne-aap neeche ludhakti hai, par upar chadhaane mein zor lagta hai.
Membrane ke ek taraf H⁺ zyada aur doosri taraf kam hon, toh H⁺ ki is dhalaan ko proton gradient kehte hain; gradient ka matlab hi dhalaan hai.
ATP banna isi dhalaan ke banne se juda hai: pehle dhalaan banti hai, phir H⁺ dhalaan se neeche bahte hain, aur us bahav se ATP banta hai. Dhalaan nahi, toh ATP nahi.
Bilkul baandh ki tarah: pehle paani ek taraf roka jaata hai, aur chhodne par usi se bijli banti hai.
Chloroplast mein yeh H⁺ thaili ke andar, yaani lumen mein, jama hote hain: andar zyada, bahar stroma mein kam.
Yahi tareeka aap aage respiration wale chapter mein mitochondria mein bhi padhoge. Jeevon mein ATP banane ka yeh sabse aam tareeka hai.
Mitochondria ki do membranes hoti hain, ek bahar wali aur ek andar wali. Andar wali membrane mein bhi electron carriers ki ek kadi hoti hai, jise electron transport system, yaani ETS, kehte hain.
Wahan jab electron ETS mein daudte hain, toh H⁺ dono membranes ke beech ki patli jagah mein jama hote hain. Is jagah ko intermembrane space kehte hain.
Toh batao, chloroplast mein H⁺ kahan jama hote hain, aur mitochondria mein kahan?
Chloroplast mein H⁺ thylakoid ke andar, lumen mein, jama hote hain; mitochondria mein do membranes ke beech, intermembrane space mein. Tareeka ek, jagah alag; yeh farq exam ke liye pakka yaad rakho.
Ab agla sawaal: yeh dhalaan banti kaise hai? H⁺ ko andar bharta kaun hai?

H⁺ ko andar kaun bharta hai, iska jawab usi raaste mein chhupa hai jo hum pehle padh chuke hain: electron ka jaagna aur aage badhna. Isliye wahi raasta ek baar phir chalenge, par is baar nazar H⁺ par rakhenge.

Electron ka jaagna, yaani activation of electrons, aap jaante ho: roshni PS II ke reaction centre P680 aur PS I ke reaction centre P700 par padti hai, aur unka electron energy lekar upar uchhalta hai.
Uchhle electron ko sabse pehle primary acceptor pakadta hai. Phir woh electron carriers ki kadi mein ek se doosre tak aage badhta hai; yahi electron ka transport hai.
Ab Figure 11.7 dekho; ise saath-saath padhenge.
Beech mein thylakoid ki band membrane hai. Andar ki jagah par likha hai lumen, high H⁺; bahar likha hai stroma, low H⁺. Yaani andar H⁺ zyada, bahar kam.
Membrane mein PS II aur PS I baithe hain, aur dono par roshni ke teer pad rahe hain: P680 par aur P700 par.
PS II ke paas, andar ki taraf, paani toot raha hai. Wahan ½O₂ likha hai, kyunki paani ke ek molecule se aadha O₂ molecule milta hai; do molecule milkar ek poora O₂ dete hain.
Ab electron ke raaste par ungli rakh kar chalo: PS II se PQ, yaani plastoquinone; phir cytochrome b6f; phir PC, yaani plastocyanin; phir PS I.
PS I ke baad electron Fd, yaani ferredoxin, ke paas jaata hai, aur phir NADP reductase NADP⁺ se NADPH banata hai. Yeh wahi Z scheme ka raasta hai jo humne pehle padha tha.
Ab H⁺ ke teer dekho: kuch teer stroma se uthkar andar lumen mein jaate hain, aur saare teer lumen mein hi jama hote dikhte hain.

Figure mein ek machine bhi hai, jiska ek hissa membrane mein dhansa hai aur ek bahar nikla hai. Lumen ke H⁺ isi se bahar stroma mein lautte hain, aur wahin ADP + Pᵢ se ATP banta dikhaya hai. Is machine ko hum thodi der mein kholenge.
Aur ek tikona nishaan hai, jo andar high se bahar low ki taraf patla hota jaata hai; uspar likha hai electrochemical potential gradient.

Electrochemical isliye, kyunki dhalaan do cheezon ki hai. Chemical yaani ginti: andar H⁺ zyada. Electro yaani charge: H⁺ positive hain, toh andar positive charge bhi zyada. Dono milkar H⁺ ko andar se bahar ki taraf dhakelte hain.
Is poore raaste mein teen jagah H⁺ ka hisaab badalta hai. Yahi teen kaam humein dhoondhne hain: paani ka tootna, PQ ka H⁺ dhona, aur NADPH ka banna.
